Execute ALL steps in exact order. PRE-FLIGHT IS MANDATORY before any test runs. PER-TEST LOOP: process each test fully (F1→F6 on failure) before advancing. Workflow is NOT complete until Step 9 writes test-suites.yml.

step.goal: Pre-flight spec review — find and fix all issues before any test runs
step.action: Run: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --mode review --suite "{suite_name}" Read JSON output — note [BLOCKER], [WARN], [FIXED] items.

review.checks: IM-1: every import/require path resolves to an existing file | IM-2: PO class names match export-default in .page.js | IM-3: test data import path and variable name correct | IM-4: no circular imports | TD-1: testData.baseUrl matches project.config.json baseUrl | TD-2: every testData key accessed in spec exists in the JSON | TD-3: credentials from testData/config — not hardcoded | TD-4: URL paths in testData are correct for this project | TD-5: no REPLACE_WITH_REAL_PASSWORD placeholders | PW-1: every async Playwright call has await | PW-2: no page.$() or page.$$() — use page.locator() | PW-3: no page.waitForNavigation() — use waitForURL/waitForLoadState | PW-4: no page.waitForTimeout() — use proper explicit waits | PW-5: expect() from @playwright/test | PW-6: stable selectors (getByRole/Label/TestId/Text) — not fragile nth-child/XPath | TS-1: no test.only() or describe.only() | TS-2: no unexplained test.skip() | TS-3: unique descriptive test names | TS-4: beforeEach/afterEach leave no dirty state | TS-5: login in beforeEach — not duplicated in each test body | TS-6: tests are independent — no cross-test state dependency | PO-1: every PO method called in spec exists in the PO class | PO-2: PO constructor receives page from Playwright fixtures | PO-3: locators defined before use | PO-4: navigate/goto uses relative path + baseURL — not hardcoded URLs | AU-1: all login credentials from testData or config.yaml test_users | AU-2: every role in the user story has at least one test | AU-3: negative tests use clearly invalid credentials
review.fix-if-needed: Apply minimal fix for each failed check. State: "Fixed {ID}: {what changed}". Re-run the deterministic check after fixes to confirm no blockers remain. Do NOT run tests while any BLOCKER is present.

step.output:
✅ Pre-flight Review Complete — {suite_name}.spec.js
Issues found : {issues_found} Auto-fixed : {auto_fixed} (by pre-flight engine) AI-fixed : {ai_fixed} (by this review) Warnings left : {warnings} (non-blocking)
Ready to execute {test_count} tests.

step.goal: List all tests in the suite
step.action: Parse output → extract ordered test names → {test_list}
step.output: 📋 Found {N} tests — running each individually with inline fix on failure.

step.goal: Per-test execution loop with inline fix protocol
step.critical: LOOP RULE: process tests ONE AT A TIME. On FAIL: complete F1→F2→F3→F4→F5→F6 in exact order before advancing. NEVER skip any step. NEVER batch failures.
step.action:
FOR EACH {test_name} IN {test_list}:
A — Run single test: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --suite "{suite_name}" --mode single --testName "{test_name}" Capture exit code (0=PASS, non-zero=FAIL)
B — PASS (exit 0): increment {pass_count} | mark ✅ in test-checklist.md | append "✅ PASS — {test_name}" to log | advance to next test
C — FAIL (exit ≠ 0) — FAILURE PROTOCOL (complete all before next test):
F1 DIAGNOSE: read full error + stack trace; read failing spec lines; read referenced PO files. Classify: TEST BUG (wrong selector/assertion/URL/await/setup → fix spec or PO) or SOURCE BUG (broken app element/API/nav → fix application source).
F2 FIX: open root-cause file, apply minimal targeted fix, save to disk.
F3 CREATE BUG REPORT — file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/BUG-{next_bug_id:04d}.md Required sections: • Bug ID | test name | error type (خطأ في ملف الاختبار / خطأ في الكود المصدري) • الملف المُعدَّل: path edited in F2 • مستوى الخطورة: timeout/crash=حرجة | assertion/404=عالية | UI=متوسطة | minor=منخفضة • وصف الخطأ: full verbatim error message • تشخيص السبب الجذري: specific root cause (NEVER "unknown error") • الإصلاح المُطبَّق: description + before/after code snippet • سجل التتبع: full stack trace in <details> block Then increment {next_bug_id}.
F4 RETEST: run same test again with same command as step A. Capture exit code.
F5 APPEND OUTCOME to BUG-{XXXX}.md: exit 0 → append: "## ✅ تم الإصلاح — اجتاز الاختبار بعد الإصلاح\n> تم التحقق بنجاح في: {current_timestamp}" exit ≠0 → append: "## ❌ لا يزال فاشلاً — يحتاج مراجعة\n> تمت إعادة الاختبار في: {current_timestamp} — لا يزال يفشل.\n> ما تمت محاولته: {fix_description}"
F6 UPDATE CHECKLIST + LOG: exit 0 → mark ✅ in test-checklist.md | increment {fixed_inline_count} | append "🔧 FIXED — {test_name} | BUG-{next_bug_id-1}" exit ≠0 → mark ❌ in test-checklist.md | increment {still_open_count} | append "❌ OPEN — {test_name} | BUG-{next_bug_id-1}" | do NOT retry
END FOR EACH
Create/update {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/INDEX.md — table: Bug ID | Test | نوع الخطأ | الخطورة | الحالة
Run full suite for canonical JUnit XML: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --suite "{suite_name}"
Update test-checklist.md header table with final counts: Passed, Fixed-Inline, Still Failing, overall status

review.checks: P5-1: every test in {test_list} was executed — no silent skip | P5-2: every failed test has BUG-XXXX.md — zero undocumented failures | P5-3: every bug report has specific root cause (not "unknown error") | P5-4: every bug report contains before/after code fix | P5-5: every bug report has retest outcome appended | P5-6: test-checklist.md shows ✅/❌ for all tests — no ⏳ Pending remaining | P5-7: junit.xml exists and is non-empty | P5-8: BUG-XXXX.md count equals failure count
review.fix-if-needed: P5-1: re-run missing tests with --mode single | P5-2/P5-8: create missing bug reports from JUnit XML now | P5-3: rewrite vague root causes after re-reading stack trace | P5-4: add before/after code snippet to each incomplete report | P5-5: run the test again and append outcome to any report missing it | P5-6: update ⏳ entries using JUnit XML results | P5-7: re-run full suite to regenerate JUnit XML
